subject: financial_literacy
concept: Practicing delayed gratification: choosing to wait for a bigger reward instead of taking a smaller one right away
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Discipline Pillar — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student is offered a small reward now or a bigger reward after waiting, and reflects on their choice
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a 'wait and get more' scenario to its bigger eventual reward
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, what it means to wait for something better instead of taking less right away

misconception_flags: cannot articulate any reason waiting could lead to a better outcome

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
